title: "THE HEART OF A STATE"
sub: According to Sima Qian, a dying commander told a Qin officer that Panyu, guarded by mountains and the sea, could be the heart of a state.
say: According to Suh-mah Chyen, a dying commander told a Chin officer that Pahn-yoo, guarded by mountains and the sea, could be the heart of a state.

title: ZHAO TUO
sub: The officer was Zhao Tuo, from Zhending in the north.
say: The officer was Jow Twaw, from Jun-ding in the north.

title: CUT THE ROADS
sub: Zhao Tuo took command. He closed the mountain passes, cut the new roads, and replaced Qin officials with his own men.
say: Jow Twaw took command. He closed the mountain passes, cut the new roads, and replaced Chin officials with his own men.

title: KING OF NANYUE
sub: When Qin collapsed, he took Guilin and Xiang as well, and around 204 BC named himself King of Nanyue. His capital was Panyu, today's Guangzhou.
say: When Chin collapsed, he took Gway-lin and Shyahng as well, and around 204 BC named himself King of Nahn-yweh. His capital was Pahn-yoo, today's Gwahng-joe.

title: TWO CLAIMS
sub: His kingdom is claimed by both Chinese and Vietnamese history.
say: His kingdom is claimed by both Chinese and Vietnamese history.

title: CHINESE OR VIETNAMESE?
sub: So was Zhao Tuo Chinese, or Vietnamese?
say: So was Jow Twaw Chinese, or Vietnamese?
